pr_body:
A relative directory in Chromium's user-data-dir argument ends up getting resolved against the directory of `chrome.exe` rather than the `CWD` on Windows.

Relates https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/2717314

Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/34700

issue_context.title: [Bug]: user_data_dir in launch_persistent_context() resolves relative paths relative to browser executable instead of current working directory
issue_context.body:
### Version

1.50.0

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a script with:
```python
browser = await playwright.chromium.launch_persistent_context(
    user_data_dir='./user_data',
    # user_data_dir='user_data', # same result
    executable_path='./chromium/chrome.exe'
)
```
2. Run the script from a working directory different from the browser's executable location
3. Observe where the user_data directory is actually created

### Expected behavior

The user_data_dir should be created relative to the current working directory. (./user_data/)

### Actual behavior

The user_data_dir is created relative to the directory containing the browser executable. (./chromuim/user_data/)

### Additional context

_No response_

### Environment

```Text
- Operating System: [Windows 10]
- CPU: [x86]
- Browser: [Chromium]
- Python Version: [3.13]
- Other info:
```
